description: Visual verification rubric for HYROX station slots. A station claim is verified when stationEvidence lists at least `minEvidence` cues the rater actually saw in the file (copied from `cues`, not paraphrased loosely). Lookalikes list the known mislabel traps — if a lookalike matches better, the claim fails. Not all cues must be present; a genuine shot missing some still verifies.

positiveMarkers.eventPhotographer: Shots taken by official event photographers (arena branding, photographer pit positions, Sportograf-style framing) are a positive prior for BOTH station correctness and quality — they shoot real stations in real events. Caveat: check for watermarks/EXIF provenance (e.g. Sportograf); flag provenance in notes since demo-use ≠ licensed use.

cues: tall vertical machine with a round fan/flywheel housing at the top
two cords or handles pulled downward from overhead
athlete standing upright pulling arms down past chest/hips
wall-mounted or floor-stand base, no moving staircase
lookalikes: stair-climber/stepmill — has steps and side rails, no overhead cords
versa climber — thin rail with pegs, no fan housing

cues: sled/prowler with tall vertical push posts
athlete leaning forward, arms extended, behind the sled driving it
weight plates loaded on the sled
pushing along a marked lane or track
lookalikes: sled pull — rope in hands instead of posts
tank/push-resistance machine — fixed-frame machine, not a free sled

cues: thick rope held in both hands
athlete leaning back or walking backward hauling
sled visible at the far end of the rope or rope taut toward it
pulling along a lane
lookalikes: battle ropes — ropes in waves, no sled
cable machine pull — fixed pulley, no free sled

cues: athlete chest or hands on the floor
or athlete airborne mid forward broad jump
no equipment in frame
marked lane or open floor
lookalikes: push-up/plank photo — static floor hold, not the forward-jump discipline

cues: seated athlete on a sliding seat
handle on a chain/strap pulled toward the torso
round fan housing at the foot end of the machine
legs bent driving back, monitor arm visible
lookalikes: cable-row on a weight-stack machine — no flywheel fan, fixed seat
seated lat pulldown — overhead bar not a low handle

cues: one kettlebell or dumbbell in EACH hand
weights held at the sides while walking or standing mid-stride
athlete upright in a lane
two matching implements visible
lookalikes: single-bell carry or goblet hold — one implement only
luggage or bags — not training implements

cues: soft cylindrical sandbag resting across shoulders/upper back
lunge stride — front knee bent, back knee toward floor
athlete moving along a lane
bag visibly load-bearing not held in hands
lookalikes: barbell lunges — rigid bar not a soft bag
sandbag set-down/setup area — no lunge in progress

cues: large soft medicine ball visible
ball in the air heading to a high target, or athlete squatting to throw
target line or cross marked high on a wall/rig
athlete facing the wall
lookalikes: slam ball to the floor — downward throw, no high target
basketball or small ball — wrong implement

cues: athlete mid-stride with visible flight or contact
arena track lane, marked run course, or treadmill
running posture not a station movement
lookalikes: walking between stations — upright, no stride
warm-up jog in group shot — not a race run
